interface_detail: POST https://api.valyu.ai/v1/search with an x-api-key header; Contents, Answer and DeepResearch endpoints draw on the same key and balance; a hosted MCP server is offered

chaining: A bounded search leg whose one key also reaches SEC filings, arXiv, PubMed, patents and clinical trials, priced per result; the signup balance is spent once, so it suits a finite job rather than a standing crawl
